groups.saying_opens: أليس قد علمت أن جبريل نزل فصلى
كان يصلي العصر والشمس في حجرتها

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad: Abu Mas'ud's rebuke and the Prophet's words through him (saying 1, via Urwa from Bashir from his father); Aisha's report through Urwa (saying 2)
«أبيه» stands for Abu Mas'ud, whom the story also has speaking («فدخل عليه أبو مسعود الأنصاري فقال»); the two are not merged, and the story's Umar speaks inside a narrated scene, so he is not a link
